claim: Patchline ships a reproducible foundation-model finetune with a deterministic post-hoc verification layer. The worker loads a frozen, content-addressed spec and checks every item is scored and references concrete backing evidence; the gate then re-runs the worker, confirms every item is scored and evidenced, and rejects an unsupported item with empty evidence, so the post-hoc verification claim is reproducible on real Patchline self-data via `make foundation-model-finetune-gate`.
